definition: event_ms (r): first sample after the return-lobe peak where the dominant gyro axis falls to 0.5 of that peak. Direction label: event_ms <= t < event_ms + 150 ms; everything else NONE (no ignore zone). Scoring: issued in [score_start_ms (return peak), score_end_ms (event_ms + 500 ms)]. settled_ms is the previous completion_ms, kept for reference. Sensor-derived; no video or human check.
